demoView.deleteTitle: デモファイルを削除しますか？
demoView.deleteBody: <path/> と、このデモの解析データ、すべての書き出し動画および書き出し記録を削除します。元に戻せません。残したい動画は、続行する前にバックアップしてください。

players.aimNote: One hit per fired shot, including pellets and penetrations. Head hit share excludes AWP. Bursts: same weapon/round with gaps ≤300 ms; sprays require 3+ rifle shots. No visibility filter. — means no samples; these definitions can differ from other platforms.
players.barNote: 背景バー：割合は100%、ADR・ダメージ・発砲数は試合内の最大値を基準に表示。
players.duelsNote: Row player kills column player. Percentage = kills / (kills + reverse kills). Enemy encounters only; — means no duel or same team.
players.clutchesNote: Starts when the player is the last teammate alive against at least one enemy. Survival is measured at round end; it does not imply an intentional save. Success includes all attempts.
players.tradesNote: A teammate kills your killer within 5 seconds, in the same round. Counts successful trades only; no visibility-based opportunities or attempts.
players.utilityNote: Throws count weapon_fire events. Blinds longer than 1 s count only for living targets; teammates include yourself. Blind time sums qualifying enemy durations, including overlaps. Flash assists use the death event flag. — means no throws.
players.activityNote: Enemy damage excludes overkill and friendly fire. Survival is measured through the official round end.
players.generalNote: KAST: kill, assist, survival or death traded within 5 seconds. Multi-kills: 2k / 3k / 4k / 5k rounds.
players.openingNote: First enemy kill in each round. Participation = (opening kills + opening deaths) / rounds played.
players.flashNote: フラッシュアシストはアシスト数に含まれます
players.multiKillNote: マルチキル列は 2k / 3k / 4k / 5k のラウンド数
